title: What the live paper record shows
description: The engines' own state, read from the running record: what is open, what closed, and what the market filter is doing right now.
body:
Every position in this record is paper. No real orders are placed anywhere in it. A single trade, whether it wins or loses, says nothing about a strategy. The live paper record starts for v005 on 1 October 2026 and for v006 on 9 October 2026. The first live signal was an ATOM entry at 2.066 after the 10 October 2026 daily close. That position exited below its 10-day low at the 18 October 2026 close, at 1.703, which is −17.9% after the 30 bps round trip. A NEAR entry at 5.896 on 12 October 2026 has been open since. In testing, losses were common and the average winner was roughly +19%, so a losing start is the expected case rather than a surprise.

## Engine states on the paper record

htf-rsi-v007 has 0 positions open on paper. It has 4 closed trades so far, with an average null net per trade. trend-daily-v005 has the Bitcoin market filter on, 0 positions open on paper, and 5 closed trades so far, with an average -13.68% net per trade. trend-daily-v006 also has the Bitcoin market filter on, 1 position open on paper, and 5 closed trades so far, with an average -13.68% net per trade. These are the engine states read from the running record. They describe what has happened on paper to date. They do not describe a validated edge, because the sample is small and the record is young.

Paper means no real orders are placed anywhere in this record. The prices and outcomes are recorded signals. They can show how a rule behaved on past bars. They cannot show how a live order would have filled. The live starts are staggered: v005 counts from 1 October 2026, v006 from 9 October 2026. The first live signal came after the 10 October 2026 daily close. This matters because the sample is measured from those dates, not from a longer history.

## Open positions

trend-daily-v006 has one open paper position: HYPEUSDT since 2026-10-30T00:00:00.000Z. NEAR has an entry at 5.896 on 12 October 2026 that has been open since. The ATOM entry at 2.066 after the 10 October 2026 daily close is no longer open; it exited below its 10-day low at the 18 October 2026 close at 1.703. That is the most recent closed trade described in the record. It is one trade. It cannot confirm or reject a strategy.

The market filter is on for both trend engines. The record does not say what the filter blocks or allows beyond that status. It only shows that with the filter on, v005 has 0 open positions and v006 has 1 open position. That is an observed state, not an explanation of cause.

## Closed trades so far

htf-rsi-v007 has 4 closed trades so far, with an average null net per trade. trend-daily-v005 has 5 closed trades so far, with an average -13.68% net per trade. trend-daily-v006 has 5 closed trades so far, with an average -13.68% net per trade. The ATOM exit at 1.703 is −17.9% after the 30 bps round trip. These figures are historical outcomes on paper. They are not projections.

The first closed trade in the live record is a loss. Testing suggested losses were common, with an average winner roughly +19%. That is context for reading the record, not a prediction about the next trade. A losing start is the expected case rather than a surprise under that testing history.

## Market filter and distance to breakouts

trend-daily-v005 and trend-daily-v006 both show the Bitcoin market filter on. For v005, the names closest to their 20-day breakout are UNIUSDT at 5.87% below its high, BCHUSDT at 6.65% below its high, and BNBUSDT at 7.98% below its high. For v006, the names closest to their 20-day breakout are UNIUSDT at 5.87% below its high, HYPEUSDT at 6.50% below its high, and BCHUSDT at 6.65% below its high. The record states the filter status and these distances. It does not state what the filter will do next, and no entry or exit is being recommended.

Breakout distances are snapshots of how far names are from their highs. They are not forecasts. A name closer to its high is not a recommendation. The distances are simply the measurements attached to the engine state on the date of the snapshot.

## Reading the record

The record is continuous. The snapshot used here was read at 2026-11-03T20:22:58.770Z. The same numbers appear on the performance page, in the signal log, and in the status posted to the channel. Because every entry is paper, the record shows engine state and historical paper outcomes, not live trading results. It updates as new closes arrive, and the most useful reading is to compare the open positions, the closed trades, and the filter status as they stand on the date of the snapshot.
